next.reason: A record-name is a level-01 data-name. §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR4 admits as data-name-2 any 'name associated with a level number to which the item being qualified is subordinate', which includes a level-01 record. Format 1 of §2023:8.4.2.2.2 takes any data-name-1, record-names included. Same programs accepted.
